name: Inui Naochika
source:
The Academy's headmaster and one of its founders. He's an influential man, famous for his extraordinary magical prowess and his clout with some of the country's leaders.
Inui is also a man of character, who lives an exemplary life without letting the extravagance of his position blind him.
Thirdly, he's quite popular, with a not-inconsiderable amount of admires.
Some have witnessed him taking the time to encourage students he runs across.
He has reaped the benefits of a healthy lifestyle, as he shows few signs of aging even after his sixtieth birthday.
